title: Merengue and bachata: music of the Dominican Republic
goal: Tell how merengue and bachata changed over the years with the verbs of change (*ponerse*, *volverse*, *hacerse*, *quedarse*).
grammar: verbs of change, applied to merengue and bachata

items: I can say how something changed with *ponerse*, *volverse*, *hacerse* or *quedarse*.
I can say which instruments play typical merengue and where bachata comes from.
I can use the new words for the güira, the tambora, the requinto and the radio.
